newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguayan inflation 1.34 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Uruguayan inflation 1.34 pct in May.

text.p: Uruguayan consumer prices rose 1.34 percent in May, down from 1.42 percent in April and 2.09 percent in May 1996, the National Statistics Institute said Thursday.

Accumulated inflation for the first five months of 1997 was 7.89 percent, against 10.82 percent in the same period last year. In the year to May, inflation was 21.05 percent, the lowest since December 1982, the institute said.
The Uruguayan government aims to cut inflation to between 14 and 17 percent in 1997, from 24.2 percent last year.
